name: Architect-to-Editor Split Build
description: Separate deciding WHAT to change from mechanically applying it: an Opus architect emits a typed change-spec, a Codex editor applies it. The change-spec - not the conversation - is the durable, reviewable, re-appliable artifact, so a different editor can reproduce the change. The lint ladder is capped at max_reflections and the attempt after the cap ESCALATES to the lead for re-decomposition; it never becomes a further retry.

goal.description: What must change, in one sentence

repo_map_path.description: PageRank-ranked symbol map over LSP reference edges - the grounding, not a vector store

max_reflections.description: Lint-ladder cap. The attempt after this one escalates; it is never a retry.

sandbox.description: Windows has no native OS process sandbox, so any change that EXECUTES anything routes off-native

editor_vendor.description: Editor vendor. Defaulting to the non-architect vendor is the point of the split.

architect.description: Decides the change and emits a typed change-spec complete enough that the editor needs no judgement

editor.description: Applies the change-spec verbatim and fails LOUDLY on an under-specified spec instead of improvising

lead.description: Re-decomposes the work unit when the editor breaches the failure threshold

routes.reason: the editor is deliberately a different vendor from the architect

stages.title: S0 GROUND with a PageRank repo map

work_unit.title: Rank the symbols the change will touch, using LSP reference edges
work_unit.question_or_target: Produce the ranked symbol neighbourhood of the goal so the change-spec is grounded in the real call graph.
work_unit.evidence_requirement: every ranked symbol is reachable from a real reference edge, not from a name-similarity guess
tests_required: a symbol with no inbound reference edge must not appear in the ranked neighbourhood
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the lead reads the map before the change-spec is accepted
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-ARC02-S0 only when every ranked symbol cites the reference edge that ranked it; otherwise FAILED:BP3-ARC02-S0 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot to a narrower symbol seed

stages.title: S1 ARCHITECT emits a typed change-spec

work_unit.title: Emit a typed change-spec the editor can apply without judgement
work_unit.question_or_target: Write the complete change-spec: per file, the exact edit intent, the acceptance check, and the rollback.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the deciding is the hard part and belongs on the strongest model

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each edit names the file, the anchor it applies at, the acceptance check, and the rollback step
tests_required: a spec entry with no acceptance check must FAIL validation, since the editor could not tell success from failure
a spec that leaves an edit anchor ambiguous must FAIL rather than let the editor choose
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the editor is the reviewer of record: if it needs to ask, the spec is incomplete
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-ARC02-S1 only when every edit carries an anchor, an acceptance check and a rollback; otherwise FAILED:BP3-ARC02-S1 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot to a decomposed spec of smaller units

stages.title: S1 gate: an under-specified spec must not reach the editor
S2 EDITOR applies the spec, S3 LINTs only the changed files

work_unit.title: Apply the change-spec through a BLOCKING cross-vendor dispatch
work_unit.question_or_target: Apply every edit in the change-spec verbatim, and fail loudly on any entry that requires a judgement call.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: cross-vendor diversity per work unit; the editor is not the architect

work_unit.evidence_requirement: exit code 0 AND a non-empty parseable output artifact AND that artifact validates against the declared schema - all three, never exit code alone
tests_required: a result string containing 'started in the background' or 'Check /codex:status' must be REJECTED as a receipt, not accepted as a result
an under-specified spec entry must produce FAILED with the entry id, never an improvised edit
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the lint ladder, then the lead on threshold breach
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-ARC02-S2 only when the dispatch was foreground, the output artifact exists and parses, and it validates against its schema; otherwise FAILED:BP3-ARC02-S2 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: bounded by the loop convergence at max_reflections; the attempt after the cap escalates instead

work_unit.title: Lint only the files the editor changed
work_unit.question_or_target: Run the project lint over exactly the changed file set, so cost scales with the diff and not with the repo.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: a changed-file-only lint is the smallest check that could still catch this change

work_unit.evidence_requirement: records the exact command, its exit code, and the changed-file list it was given
tests_required: a lint over an EMPTY changed-file set must FAIL closed, because a lint that examined nothing is not a pass
the lint must be verified against a known-bad file before its silence counts as clean
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: none - exit code plus the both-states control is the evidence
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-ARC02-S3 only when the changed-file set is non-empty and the recorded command exited 0; otherwise FAILED:BP3-ARC02-S3 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: bounded by the loop; a lint failure feeds the next reflection

stages.title: S2 gate: a background receipt is not a result
S3 gate: lint clean, or the ladder is spent
S4 ESCALATE to the lead for re-decomposition - never a fourth attempt

work_unit.title: Decide whether the spec, the decomposition, or the editor failed
work_unit.question_or_target: Attribute the repeated failure to the change-spec, the unit decomposition, or the editor rail, and enumerate at least two alternatives.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: re-decomposition is a judgement the lead owns

work_unit.evidence_requirement: names the failing fingerprint and at least two mechanically different alternatives
tests_required: an escalation offering fewer than two alternatives must FAIL - that is a retry wearing an escalation label
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the owner when the alternatives all require a scope change
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-ARC02-S4D only when at least two mechanically different alternatives are enumerated; otherwise FAILED:BP3-ARC02-S4D <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: none; this stage IS the pivot

stages.title: S5 gate the applied change on the shared 12-condition predicate

impact.blast_radius: the editor mutates repo files; every edit carries a declared rollback and the change-spec can be re-applied or reverted

consumers: any future editor re-applying the change

x_extensions.distinguishing_mechanism: a typed change-spec crosses the vendor boundary and the lint ladder is CAPPED, so the attempt after the cap is a re-decomposition rather than a fourth try. BP-IMP-01 is the per-work-unit quality pipeline; this is the role split INSIDE its implement step and nests within it.
cross_vendor_dispatch_constraints: the dispatch MUST block: a job id or a 'started in the background' string is not a result
pass the prompt BY FILE: Windows CreateProcess caps a command line at 32,767 chars
pass --ignore-user-config on every non-interactive invocation, so the active MCP inventory cannot blow the arg limit
set an explicit 30-minute timeout; the silent 10-minute default is what makes agents reach for --background

worked_example.name: the lint ladder escalates on the fourth attempt
worked_example.narrative: The editor applies the spec and the changed-file lint fails three times in a row. With max_reflections=3 the ladder stops at three and the outcome is 'escalate' with three attempts used - a fourth attempt must never be made. The control shows the same input reaching 'clean' when the second attempt succeeds, which proves the ladder is not simply always escalating.

controls.why: the ladder must be capable of both outcomes, or it measures nothing
